The fur is dark brown and shaggy, particularly around the head and shoulders. Short, curved horns are visible. The background consists of blurred trees and a blue sky.

The eye is visible and appears dark, though partially shadowed by fur.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and blended into the thick fur of the head, which is typical for bison.
